sentences.en: Anders disassociated himself from an increasingly corrupt board of directors.
sentences.zh: 安德斯与日益腐败的董事会断绝了关系。

sentences.en: He was accused of corrupting morals and spreading dangerous ideas.
sentences.zh: 他被指控败坏道德并传播危险的思想。

sentences.en: Algeria was badly managed by a bunch of corrupt politicians.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚由一群腐败的政治家管理得一团糟。
